correctness.rationale: All-dimensional d>=3 solid-ball normalized Lebesgue polynomial degree<=2 space decomposes under swaps of x1,x2 and O(d-2) on remaining y: symmetric scalar 4, antisymmetric scalar 2, (d-2) copies of symmetric vector 2 and antisymmetric vector 1, and residual quadratics dimension C(d-1,2). Beta/Gamma moment formula for |x|^alpha is exact, with the quarter-ball moments one fourth of signed absolute moments for first two coordinates, and odd residual exponents killed. Conditional expectation E(|y|²|x1,x2)=(d-2)/d(1-x1²-x2²) yields orthogonal radial-residual polynomial, plus trace-free y modes with eigenvalue 1/4. Gram normalization yields antisymmetric A_d and vector V_d with off diagonal c_d and 2c_d; 4x4 generalized spectrum uses explicit b0..b3 moment matrices. Multiplicities sum C(d+2,2). Independently constructed full monomial Gram moment pencil and invariant reduced blocks (not executing unchecked package code): eigenvalue lists match numerically at d=3,4,5,7; analytic orthogonality gives all-d proof. Trace = dim/4 and Rayleigh extrema sharp.
